description: Discovers eligible C# project units by nearest-ancestor .csproj ownership of .cs source files under the exported commit tree. No build, restore, package resolution or code execution is performed; files are only enumerated, classified and hashed.
rules: A .csproj file defines a project unit rooted at its containing directory.
A .cs file is owned by the nearest ancestor directory that contains exactly one .csproj file.
A directory that contains more than one .csproj file is ambiguous: every file directly under it is reported unsupported with code ambiguous-project-directory.
Embedded-source extensions (.csx, .razor, .cshtml) are outside the declared csharp.project.v1 input profile and are reported unsupported-embedded-source.
Non-C# source files are reported unsupported-input-profile rather than silently dropped.
Manifest excludedPathPrefixes remove matching paths from consideration before ownership is resolved.
Symbolic links and files outside the project root are reported linked-input or source-outside-project and never followed.
